Amended after adversarial probing (0 FP / 0 FN on 36 probes; shipped pattern scored 3 FP / 6 FN; no collision with the other 14 round-3 rules).

WHAT CHANGED. (i) The energy symbol is no longer hard-coded to E: Srednicki prints (2π)³2ω δ³, Schwartz and the amplitudes literature print 2ω_p, and 2ε_p is standard where \varepsilon denotes the on-shell energy — the shipped pattern missed its OWN branch in all three typesettings. (ii) The exponent accepts d−1 for the dim-reg measure d^{d−1}p/((2π)^{d−1}2E_p). (iii) The optional `\)?` before 2E is DELETED. After foldFractions, a 2E inside the denominator has no paren before it ('((2 pi )^3 2E_p)'); the optional paren fired only when the 2E sat OUTSIDE a closed fraction, which is exactly the false-positive geometry — it swallowed condensed-matter spin-degeneracy-2 energy densities, E-as-elastic-modulus, and f-sum rules. Removing it also makes the ω widening safe (2ω_q outside a closed measure no longer fires). (iv) The third alternative no longer requires a leading '=' (it must catch [a,a†] = … too) but now REQUIRES a trailing δ, and its window is 32 characters. (v) \bigl/\bigr/\Bigl… are tolerated inline because normalizeProse does not strip them — its stripper is /\\(?:left|right|big|Big|bigg|Bigg)\b/ and the \b fails on \bigl. That is a normalizer gap worth fixing in src/detect.ts independently of this rule.

DELIBERATE EXCLUSIONS. Bold \mathbf{E} is not accepted as the energy symbol — bold E is an electric field far more often than an energy, and admitting it re-opens the homograph. Bare \epsilon/ε is not accepted either (permittivity, Feynman iε).

RESIDUAL PHYSICS LIMIT — the measure leg is EVIDENCE, not determination. ∫d³p/((2π)³2E) is also convention-free on-shell kinematics: ∫d⁴p δ(p²−m²)θ(p⁰) = ∫d³p/2E is printed in relativistic kinetic theory, thermal field theory, and cosmological Boltzmann papers that instantiate no ⟨p|p′⟩ at all. A measure-only hit should therefore be emitted as evidence for the relativistic branch and degraded to *undetermined* (or the §5 round-4 'present but inert' verdict) unless a state-normalization or ladder-commutator line — pattern alternative (c) — is also present in the span. Only alternative (c) determines the branch. Likewise, a branch quoted as a contrast the paper rejects fires here; that is a span-level context problem the census already handles under §6.2, not a defect of the printed form.

UNCHANGED GAP. Box normalization (1/√(2E_pV)) is still not covered here, and neither is Weinberg's δ³-only convention; both are correctly silent under this pattern, and the fork row should name all four branches.

(1) PHYSICS: the shipped rule bundled masses and frequencies under one printed form m^det = (1+z)m^src, but f^det = f^src/(1+z) — the factor is inverted, and M f is frame-invariant, which is exactly why templates are written in detector-frame masses AND detector-frame frequencies. Worse, the dominant observational convention is MIXED (source-frame masses, detector-frame frequencies): LVK catalogs quote source-frame masses at a detector-frame f_ref. A single document-level tag over both classes is therefore unsound; this rule is mass-only, and the frequency leg is owed its own rule with the inverse factor. (2) FALSE POSITIVES: 'quantities|parameters|values' were field-agnostic — they fired on collider lab-frame, neutrino-telescope and direct-detection prose, none of it a redshift statement; removed. A same-sentence 'source-frame' veto (lookbehind + lookahead, 160 chars, period-bounded) kills the rival-branch conversion boilerplate ('we convert the detector-frame masses to the source frame'), which is present in essentially every source-frame paper and was the rule's largest realistic FP class; the census remedy (§6.2 span + conflict flag) is complementary, not a substitute, since a lone conversion sentence is not a frame declaration. The veto is deliberately conservative: a genuine detector-frame declaration that names the source frame in the same sentence now emits negative evidence rather than a tag. (3) NORMALIZATION: verified through normalizeProse — survives Wikipedia braced fractions, \left/\right, \, and \; spacing, ZWSP, newlines, Mathematical-Alphanumeric glyphs, \textbf. Two residual holes a pattern cannot close: normalizeProse DELETES \mathrm{...}, \text{...}, \textrm{...}, \operatorname{...}, \mathsf{...} groups, so a phrase typeset inside one is erased before matching (a normalizer property, filed as such); and patterns compile without /i, so only sentence-case and all-caps are spelled out. The 'D_L pairing' half of the census Detection cell is still unencoded.
